aries: Fast to anger, fast to forget — but others may not. Impulse leaves fragments to clean up later. The lesson: pause before reacting.
taurus: Struggles to move on — not just from people, from habits that no longer fit. Comfort becomes trap. The lesson: choose growth over safety.
gemini: Too many conversations dilute depth. Switches interests before finishing. The lesson: one thing, all the way through.
cancer: Reactive emotion — can pull others into moods they didn't create. Struggles to say a firm no. The lesson: boundaries ≠ cruelty.
leo: Need for recognition can drown out voices around you. Pride turns to ego if unattended. The lesson: appreciate others before asking to be appreciated.
virgo: Detailed critique becomes a standard nobody can meet — including you. Perfectionism is the enemy in disguise. The lesson: enough, not perfect.
libra: People-pleases past its own voice. Struggles to decide out of fear of disappointing. The lesson: not everyone needs to like you.
scorpio: Trust is slow to build; once broken, hard to rebuild. Jealousy and control leak out quietly. The lesson: letting go isn't losing.
sagittarius: Honesty can wound when the room isn't read. Runs from commitment in the name of "freedom". The lesson: staying is also brave.
capricorn: Work becomes a shield against feeling. Rarely asks for help; pride carries the load alone. The lesson: weakness isn't failure.
aquarius: Detachment can be a way to avoid intimacy. Big vision but sometimes forgets the person right in front. The lesson: close in is also worthwhile.
pisces: Absorbs others' emotions until yours are unclear. Escapism (sleep, scroll, alcohol) becomes the shortcut. The lesson: boundaries = love.
